A workflow contract test must prove exactly one cell receives coverage flags and the other three receive none, with explicit non-empty/empty-string conditions to avoid GitHub Actions empty-string falsy traps.

Django, NumPy, and SciPy surveys confirm a consensus pattern of selective single-cell coverage collection on primary or dedicated configurations while broader compatibility jobs remain uninstrumented, with no documented rejection of this practice.
